text:
Eleanor Tsai: Quick heads-up — final onsite for candidate Aiden P. (high‑school internship program). They're 17, guardian will accompany. Need to confirm we have parental consent form, escort rules, and a waiting area for guardian.
Marcus Bell: good call. minors require a signed Minor Consent + Photo/Media waiver. Do we have a template?
HR Compliance: we do. I'll attach the Minor Consent and Volunteer/Visitor Media Waiver PDFs to the calendar invite. Guardian must sign in-person at check-in.
Olivia Chen: Reception note: minors cannot roam unescorted. Security will badge them as "Guest - Minor" and escort required at all times. Guardian ID required. Meet at North Lobby. Call desk: +1-555-678-2100.
Eleanor Tsai: timeline: Aiden + guardian arriving 4:40pm, interview 5:15pm-7:00pm. Want a quiet room and a sibling-friendly waiting area for the guardian (they requested somewhere with a power outlet).
Ava Li: I can reserve Conf E3 for interview and the lounge seating area (Room F) for guardian. Will add a small power strip and water.
Marcus Bell: parking? guardian might drive. We can issue a visitor parking pass for one vehicle — ask for plate.
Olivia Chen: we can hold a temporary hangtag and reserved curb spot. We'll need plate number by 3pm today to print permit.
HR Compliance: additional compliance note: we need a signed background-check consent if offer moves forward, but not required pre-offer. Also minors can't access sensitive rooms — mark access restricted on badge.
Security: confirmed — badges for minors will be "escort-only" and disabled for door access except the interview room. We'll arrange an escort from North Lobby to Conf E3.
Eleanor Tsai: can someone meet at 4:30pm to check paperwork and escort to the room?
Ava Li: I can meet at 4:30pm. Putting a 4:25pm meetup on calendar with Olivia + Security.
Marcus Bell: catering/dietary? Aiden is nut-allergic per app. Kitchen to prep nut-free boxed dinner + vegetarian option for guardian.
Olivia Chen: Reception: when they arrive, ask guardian to check-in and present photo ID; then text "Aiden P - arrived" to +1-555-678-2100. We'll bring the consent forms for signature.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: Attachments required before onsite: ["Minor Consent.pdf", "Media Waiver.pdf", "Visitor Rules - Minors.txt"]. Badge request logged: Aiden Park (Minor). Escort flag set.
Marcus Bell: travel stipend? guardian requests mileage reimbursement as they're driving from out of town (~45 miles). We offer up to $40 for candidate guardians for internship visits. Please send expense instructions.
Eleanor Tsai: instruct them to forward parking/toll receipts to expenses@redwood.ai with subject "Candidate Guardian Travel - Aiden Park - [date]". Reimburse within 5 business days.
Ava Li: added folio link and confirmed lounge reservation in the invite. Also added note: "guardian may wait in Room F, outlet and water provided".
HR Compliance: legal quick note: do not collect SSN or DOB on the day of interview. Only request forms listed. If family asks, redirect to onboarding team after offer.
Security: escort assigned: Officer D. Mills will meet at North Lobby at 4:30pm.
Eleanor Tsai: panelists — please confirm whether you need remote backup; Zoom is reserved in case of travel delay.
Marcus Bell: panel confirmed; backup only if >20m delay.
Olivia Chen: printing consent forms now. Also will have a laminated map showing lactation room and family restroom.
Eleanor Tsai: one more thing — Aiden's teacher sent a signed School Release letter; HR will keep a copy. Please ask guardian to bring the physical letter.
HR Compliance: noted. We'll scan and securely store a copy in the candidate folder if they permit.
Marcus Bell: closing the loop — checklist: consent + media waiver attached, escort assigned, lounge reserved, parking pass held, nut-free meal requested, expense instructions shared. Ping here if any change.
People Ops Bot: This thread will be archived in 7 days per channel retention policy.
